definition_used: Duplication of a published item, or undefined sections of it.
caution: Duplication may overlap with plagiarism or self-plagiarism, but the definition is broad and does not specify intent or source. Actor context is unclear as the definition does not indicate who identified or investigated the duplication.
semantic_rationale: Duplication of a published item or sections of it directly impacts the reliability of research content (research_content_reliability) and raises concerns about proper attribution and disclosure (attribution_authorship_disclosure_integrity). The problem object is the article as a whole, and the process signal is content reuse or duplication. No specific actor is mentioned in the definition.
